시편-15-1.title: 시편 15장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-15-1.exegesis: 7. captivity-- denotes any great evil. Zion-- God's abode, from which He revealed His purposes of mercy, as He now does by the Church (compare Psa 3:4 ; 20:2 ), and which He rules and in which He does all other things for the good of His people ( Ep 1:22 ).

시편-15-2.title: 시편 15장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-15-2.exegesis: PSALM 15 Psa 15:1-5 . Those who are fit for communion with God may be known by a conformity to His law, which is illustrated in various important particulars. 1. abide-- or, "sojourn" (compare Psa 5:4 ), where it means under God's protection here, as ( Psa 23:6 , 27:4 , 6 ) communion. tabernacle-- seat of the ark ( 2Sa 6:17 ), the symbol of God's presence. holy hill-- (Compare Psa 2:6 ).

시편-15-3.title: 시편 15장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-15-3.exegesis: 2. walketh-- (Compare Psa 1:1 ). uprightly-- in a complete manner, as to all parts of conduct ( Ge 17:1 ), not as to degree. worketh-- or, "does." righteousness-- what is right. in his heart-- sincerely ( Pr 23:7 ).

시편-15-4.title: 시편 15장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-15-4.exegesis: 3. He neither slanders nor spreads slander.
시편-15-4.theologicalNote: 3. He neither slanders nor spreads slander.

시편-15-5.title: 시편 15장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-15-5.exegesis: 4. Love and hate are regulated by a regard to God. sweareth ... hurt-- or what so results (compare Le 5:4 ).
